headline.text: L2 ML3 demolding plate and *bolt broke off* during run — metal detector test-verified before restart, no FM found in product.

summary: One active quality flag: L1 S1 pouches missing date/lot codes in last 10 minutes of window, operator coaching underway. L2 ML3 demoulder plate failure investigated and cleared; MD confirmed FM rejection capability.

food_safety.title: ML3 demoulder sliding plate broke off, bolt missing
food_safety.summary: Maintenance welded plate and searched line for missing bolt; FSQA tested sample metal pieces through MD — all rejected — line cleared to restart with enhanced monitoring.
food_safety.status: Resolved — MD test confirmed detection, visual search completed, line restarted with monitoring plan.

quality.title: S1 Matrix 9 Videojet printer failed mid-shift
quality.summary: Printer stopped working; maintenance swapped in newly commissioned unit from VideoJet, line resumed normal printing.
quality.status: Resolved — new printer installed and running.

quality.title: S1 pouches missing date and lot code prints
quality.summary: Line leader observed several pouches in the last 10 minutes without date/batch prints; pack operators reminded to verify print on every pouch.
quality.status: Open — coaching delivered to pack team at end of window.

quality.title: VFFS pouches folding at bottom seal
quality.summary: Seal defect caused pouch fold; all affected pouches pulled from line, maintenance corrected issue, QA verified seal quality restored.
quality.status: Resolved — defective pouches removed, seal corrected and verified.

quality.title: S4 caramel cook times extended to 60 minutes
quality.summary: Investigation determined operators pausing cook cycle to manage reserve tank caused burn-on; OPL reviewed with all shifts to prevent pausing.
quality.status: Resolved — root cause identified, operators retrained on OPL.

quality.title: ML3 open pouches found in box inspection
quality.summary: QA box check found 3 open flow-wrap units (2 T3, 1 T4) in one box; flagged for line attention.
quality.status: Resolved — caught during routine QA inspection.

sanitation.title: S2 dirty molds left at end of 1st shift
sanitation.summary: Shift 1 team left unwashed molds; 2nd shift washed and ATP'd them before use; team reminded to clean and store molds at shift end.
sanitation.status: Resolved — molds washed and ATP verified by 2nd shift.

sanitation.title: Mold washer area standing water cleared
sanitation.summary: Standing water in mold washer area cleaned up by mold washer lead; area verified dry.

opportunities.title: Review S1 pack area line-of-sight to Videojet printers or add audible alarm for print failures — today's missing date/lot codes were caught by visual check 10 minutes after occurrence.
opportunities.text: Review S1 pack area line-of-sight to Videojet printers or add audible alarm for print failures — today's missing date/lot codes at 17:14 were caught by visual check after unknown duration.
